issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Typewise Nova
products.tagline: AI customer experience that builds and improves itself
products.summaryZh: 自我构建与优化的AI客户体验
products.descriptionZh: Nova 是 AI 运营者，无需开发者即可构建并持续优化你的 AI 客户体验团队。用平实语言描述应如何处理客户，并连接你的工具。Nova 会构建智能体，用历史工单进行测试，并在上线前向你展示哪些环节出了问题。运行后，它全天候监控质量并提交修复建议供你审批。智能体可跨电子邮件、聊天和 WhatsApp 处理完整请求，从订单、退款到套餐变更。未解决的请求免费。
products.description: Nova is the AI Operator that builds and improves your AI customer experience team, no developer required. Describe in plain language how customers should be handled and connect your tools. Nova builds the agents, tests them on past tickets and shows you what failed before anything goes live. Once running, it monitors quality and proposes fixes 24/7 for approval. Agents resolve whole requests, from orders and refunds to plan changes, across email, chat and WhatsApp. Unresolved requests are free.

products.name: AI Observability by OpenObserve
products.tagline: OpenTelemetry-native observability for agents and LLMs
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体和LLM的OpenTelemetry原生可观测性
products.descriptionZh: 你的 agent 花了 40 美元、耗时 34 秒。但原因是什么？OpenObserve 追踪每一次 agent 会话，覆盖模型、工具、服务、数据存储和用户会话，让你准确看到时间、金钱和质量都花在了哪里。检测循环、运行在线评估，并从 LLM 调用一路追踪故障，贯穿你的后端和数据库，同时结合生产栈其余部分的日志、追踪和指标。
products.description: Your agent cost $40 and took 34 seconds. But why? OpenObserve traces every agent session across models, tools, services, datastores, and user sessions so you can see exactly where time, money, and quality went. Detect loops, run online evals, and follow failures from the LLM call through your backend and database, alongside the logs, traces, and metrics from the rest of your production stack.

products.name: Live Captions by Subanana
products.tagline: Your whole audience follows, in their own language
products.summaryZh: 你的全部受众都能以自己的语言跟进
products.descriptionZh: 你只需说一次。观众扫描二维码，选择一种语言，就能在自己的手机上实时跟随你——可以阅读，也可以收听。在大屏幕上显示两种语言，或将干净的信号输出到 OBS 和 vMix。
products.description: You speak once. Your audience scans a QR code, picks a language, and follows you live on their own phone — reading it, or hearing it. Put two languages on the big screen, or send a clean feed into OBS and vMix.

products.name: Suno v6
products.tagline: The first Suno model built with the music industry
products.summaryZh: 首个与音乐产业共同打造的Suno模型
products.descriptionZh: Suno v6是新一代音乐模型，提供三种版本：旗舰版v6、探索版v6-wild和免费版v6-mini。无需重制曲目即可编辑某一部分或歌词，混搭你自己的歌曲，并可从文本、音频、图像或视频开始创作。
products.description: Suno v6 is a new generation of music models in three flavors: flagship v6, exploratory v6-wild, and free v6-mini. Edit one section or lyric without remaking the track, mash up your own songs, and start from text, audio, images, or video.

products.name: FreeScan.app
products.tagline: Fix what’s hurting your visibility, trust, and conversions
products.summaryZh: 修复损害你可见性、信任度和转化率的问题
products.descriptionZh: 免费审计任何公开 URL，无需注册。FreeScan 发现 SEO、AEO、GEO、安全、无障碍和设计方面的问题与遗漏机会。每项发现都包含证据、重要性说明和修复方法。Pro 可自动执行全站审计，将结果整理到 SEO、AI Visibility 和 Fixes 工作区，跟踪改进与回归，创建可供代理使用的产物，通过 MCP 连接编码代理，监控正常运行时间，并发送每周报告和停机警报。
products.description: Audit any public URL for free, no signup. FreeScan uncovers problems and missed opportunities across SEO, AEO, GEO, security, accessibility, and design. Every finding includes evidence, why it matters, and how to fix it. Pro runs automated site-wide audits, organizes results into SEO, AI Visibility, and Fixes workspaces, tracks improvements and regressions, creates agent-ready artifacts, connects coding agents through MCP, monitors uptime, and sends weekly reports and downtime alerts.

products.name: Desert Ant Labs
products.tagline: Small specialized AI models for speech, text, vision
products.summaryZh: 用于语音、文本和视觉的小型专用AI模型
products.descriptionZh: Desert Ant Labs 打造在手机或浏览器上运行的小型 AI 模型，无需联网，无按次使用费用。他们不做一个大模型包揽一切，而是做多个小模型，每个专精一项任务，覆盖语音、文本和视觉。通过一个 SDK，只需几行代码即可添加任意模型。每月活跃设备 10 万台以内免费。
products.description: Desert Ant Labs builds small AI models that run on your phone or browser, no internet, no per-use cost. Instead of one big model doing everything, they make small ones, each nailing one task, across speech, text, and vision. Add any model in a few lines of code via one SDK. Free up to 100k monthly active devices.

products.name: Modeinspect
products.tagline: 99 Days Free AI Credits - Design product UI in your codebase
products.summaryZh: 99天免费AI额度 - 在你的代码库中设计产品UI
products.descriptionZh: 大多数软件都要经历两次设计：先是一张图，然后再用代码实现一遍。意图在两者之间流失。Modeinspect 是 AI 设计画布，直接针对真实产品进行设计。连接你的代码库，打开现有界面，用你的组件、令牌、实时数据、状态和断点来设计。用 AI 探索，保留真正重要的细节。准备好后，将改动实时发布，或发送给工程团队审核。何时上线由你决定。画布不是终点，产品才是。
products.description: Most software is designed twice: a picture first, then again in code. Intent drifts in between. Modeinspect is the AI design canvas for working on the real thing. Connect your codebase, open an existing screen, and design with your components, tokens, live data, states, and breakpoints. Explore with AI. Keep details that matter. When ready, publish your changes live or send them to engineering for review. You decide when they go live. The canvas is not the destination. The product is.

products.name: Thousand
products.tagline: Git-backed docs for humans and agents
products.summaryZh: 面向人类和代理的 Git 支持文档
products.descriptionZh: 基于 Git 的文档，具备真正的访问控制，集中在一个 markdown 仓库中，支持文件夹级权限，让团队成员、外部人员和 AI 代理各自只能看到自己的文件夹。
products.description: Git-backed docs with real access control, in one markdown repo with folder-level access where teammates, outsiders and AI agents each see exactly their folders.

products.name: Speechmark
products.tagline: Private, on-device meeting notes for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的私密、设备端会议笔记
products.descriptionZh: Speechmark 是一款私密的 macOS 会议记录应用。它完全在你的 Mac 上录制、转写并总结会议——包括决策、行动项、带说话人归属的转写文本。无需机器人加入通话，无需账户，一次性付费。通过 MCP 服务器与 Claude Code 良好集成。
products.description: Speechmark is a private macOS meeting-notes app. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings entirely on your Mac — decisions, action items, speaker-attributed transcripts. No bot joins the call, no account, one-time price. Integrates well with Claude Code using MCP server.

products.name: Viso Now
products.tagline: Build computer vision applications with AI
products.summaryZh: 使用AI构建计算机视觉应用
products.descriptionZh: Viso Now 是一个自构建 AI 视觉平台，可将图像、视频和摄像头画面转化为可用的计算机视觉应用。描述你想理解的内容，Viso Now 便会构建智能体视觉逻辑和自定义实时仪表盘。全程无需模型训练、标注或编写代码。
products.description: Viso Now is a self-building AI vision platform that turns images, video, and camera feeds into working computer vision applications. Describe what you want to understand, and Viso Now builds the agentic vision logic and custom live dashboards. All without model training, annotation, or writing code.

products.name: Whip
products.tagline: Youtube for interactive web experiences
products.summaryZh: YouTube 用于互动网页体验
products.descriptionZh: Whip 是互动体验的信息流。直接在浏览器中发现并游玩游戏、3D 世界、互动故事、生成艺术、数据可视化、音乐玩具等。创作者可获得频道、可分享页面、播放次数、点赞和评论，让作品能够积累受众，而不是消失在时间线中。
products.description: Whip is a feed for the interactive expeirences. Discover and play games, 3D worlds, interactive stories, generative art, data visualizations, music toys, and more directly in your browser. Creators get channels, shareable pages, play counts, likes, and comments, so their work can build an audience instead of disappearing into a timeline.

products.name: Wealthfolio
products.tagline: Private, local-first personal finance
products.summaryZh: 私密、本地优先的个人财务
products.descriptionZh: Wealthfolio 是一款开源的个人财务应用，用于跟踪投资、净资产、支出和财务目标。你的财务数据存储在本地，核心应用无需账户或订阅即可使用。可在桌面端、iPhone、iPad 上使用，也可自行托管。如果你希望减少手动维护，Wealthfolio Connect 增加了自动券商同步、端到端加密的设备同步和家庭共享功能。
products.description: Wealthfolio is an open-source personal finance app for tracking investments, net worth, spending and financial goals. Your financial data is stored locally and the core app works without an account or subscription. Use it on desktop, iPhone, iPad or self-host it. If you want less manual upkeep, Wealthfolio Connect adds automatic brokerage sync, end-to-end encrypted device sync and household sharing.

products.name: hob
products.tagline: The professional workspace for your whole agent stack
products.summaryZh: 为你的整个智能体技术栈打造的专业工作空间
products.descriptionZh: 在保持掌控的同时运行复杂的智能体工作。hob 将多个模型和独立工作流整合到一个专业工作空间中。智能体可以围绕每项任务塑造工作空间，通过它进行协调，并在其中为你提供引导。在同一系统中运行、审查、自动化和恢复智能体工作，让你无需拼凑基础设施，即可指挥更多并行工作。
products.description: Run complex agent work while staying in control. hob brings multiple models and independent workflows into one professional workspace. Agents can shape the workspace around each task, coordinate through it, and guide you inside it. Run, review, automate, and recover agent work in the same system, so you can direct more parallel work without piecing together the infrastructure.

products.name: Mock Magic: Video Presets
products.tagline: Use saved presets to quickly get a branded device video
products.summaryZh: 使用已保存的预设，快速生成带有品牌标识的设备视频
products.descriptionZh: 大多数样机工具止步于图片。Mock Magic 能把一段屏幕录制变成精致的设备视频，用你的品牌配色，在浏览器中，几秒完成。无需 Photoshop，无需 After Effects，无需安装任何东西。上传图片或视频，选择设备（iPhone 17 Pro、iPad、MacBook、Apple Watch 等），用十六进制色值设置品牌色，或添加自己的背景，然后下载。保存一次设置即可重复使用，让 App Store、网站或社交媒体的每个样机都保持一致。
products.description: Most mockup tools stop at images. Mock Magic turns a screen recording into a polished device video, in your brand colors, in the browser, in seconds. No Photoshop, no After Effects, nothing to install. Upload an image or video, pick a device (iPhone 17 Pro, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch and more), set a brand color with a hex code or add your own background, and download. Save your setup once and reuse it, so every mockup for your app store, website or socials matches.

products.name: Vibe Eyes
products.tagline: Put your pets in your macOS menu bar
products.summaryZh: 把你的宠物放进 macOS 菜单栏
products.descriptionZh: 整天坐在桌前，我会想念我的狗。所以现在，他住进了我的菜单栏。放一张照片进去，Vibe Eyes 就能把你的宠物变成菜单栏上一个会动的小头像。它会跟着你的光标移动，朝你眨眼，在你点击时眨眼示意，在你离开一段时间后抬头张望。都是些小细节，但你会发现自己忍不住抬头看一眼，然后笑了。内置十一种宠物，免费。自己制作宠物需一次性解锁 14.99 美元，外加你自己的 AI 密钥。没有订阅，没有后端，你的照片永远不会经过我的服务器。
products.description: I miss my dog when I am at my desk all day. So now he lives in my menu bar. Drop in a photo and Vibe Eyes turns your own pet into a tiny animated avatar up there. It follows your cursor, blinks at you, winks when you click and looks up when you have been away. Small stuff, but you catch yourself glancing up and smiling. Eleven pets built in, free. Making your own is a $14.99 one-time unlock plus your own AI key. No subscription, no backend, your photo never touches my server.

products.name: Gojo
products.tagline: Local dictation and everyday Mac tools in your notch
products.summaryZh: 在刘海区域实现本地听写与日常 Mac 工具
products.descriptionZh: Gojo 将本地听写、剪贴板历史、窗口控制、文件架和媒体控制放入你的 MacBook 刘海。下载语音模型后，即可在你正在使用的输入框中听写。识别在本地模式下于你的 Mac 上运行。包含日历、电池、摄像头和显示器控制。支持 macOS 14 及以上版本。提供三天试用，以及按月订阅和一次性买断授权。
products.description: Gojo puts local dictation, clipboard history, window controls, a file shelf, and media controls in your MacBook notch. Download a speech model, then dictate into the field you're using. Recognition runs on your Mac in local mode. Includes calendar, battery, camera, and display controls. macOS 14+. Three-day trial; monthly and one-time licenses.

products.name: iPhone Duo
products.tagline: The largest iPhone display ever. In a thin, foldable design.
products.summaryZh: 迄今最大的iPhone显示屏。采用轻薄可折叠设计。
products.descriptionZh: 推出 iPhone Duo，首款可折叠 iPhone。展开时，它是有史以来最薄、显示屏最大的 iPhone——比 iPhone 18 Pro Max 大 50%。它还配备外屏，屏幕面积超过 iPhone 18 Pro 的 90%。通过重新构想的 iOS 体验，它在全新姿态和方向下带来无与伦比的多功能性。这一切都融入耐用、可放入口袋的设计中。这是一款与众不同的 iPhone。
products.description: Introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone. When open, it’s the thinnest iPhone with the largest display ever — 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max. And it has an outer display with more than 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a durable, pocketable design. It’s an iPhone unlike any iPhone.

products.name: AirPods 5
products.tagline: 1.5x Active Noise Cancellation, AI Siri, Live Translation
products.summaryZh: 1.5倍主动降噪，AI Siri，实时翻译
products.descriptionZh: AirPods 5 为开放式设计带来更出色的主动降噪，同时配备更智能的 Siri，能够进行真正的对话，并支持跨语言交流的实时翻译。专为通话、锻炼和日常聆听打造。2026 年 9 月 18 日发售。
products.description: AirPods 5 brings better active noise cancellation to the open-ear design, along with a smarter Siri that can hold real conversations and live translation for talking across languages. Built for calls, workouts, and everyday listening. Available September 18, 2026.

products.name: Athenic AI
products.tagline: Beat the market with 90+ datasets and AI made for analysis
products.summaryZh: 凭借90多个数据集和专为分析打造的人工智能，超越市场表现
products.descriptionZh: 在他人之前发现投资机会。Athenic 提供价值 50,000 美元的授权机构股票数据，以及专为分析打造的 AI。用平实的语言筛选高级过滤器，获取新闻或价格变动的提醒，并自动化深度基本面研究。
products.description: Find investment opportunities before everyone else does. Athenic provides $50,000 of licensed institutional stock data plus AI specialized for analysis. Screen for advanced filters in plain English, get alerted on news or price moves, and automate deep-dive fundamentals research.

products.name: Drive
products.tagline: Vehicle telemetry for your next weekend drive with LPR alert
products.summaryZh: 为下次周末驾车出行提供车辆遥测，并附车牌识别警报
products.descriptionZh: 我曾担任Android Auto自动驾驶设计主管几年，而周末则在一辆27年车龄的老车里做着截然相反的事。Drive正是源自这种反差。它能把车里已有的手机变成遥测设备——重力加速度、刹车、过弯，完整轨迹。它还会在接近车牌识别摄像头时发出提醒，因为我重视自己的隐私。无需布线。无需适配器。无需笔记本电脑。无需注册。纯粹的驾驶乐趣。
products.description: I spent a few years as a design lead on autonomous driving for Android Auto, then spent my weekends in a 27-year-old car doing the exact opposite. Drive came out of that gap. It turns the phone already in your car into a telemetry rig — g-force, braking, cornering, the whole trace. It also flags license plate reader cameras as you approach them, since I like my privacy. No wiring loom. No dongle. No laptop. No sign up. Just driving fun.
